16.en: You have a fine eye to recognise a remarkable piece of art, but we both know that is not why you’re here.

28.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.DiCcUGLaqWptKqE9]{Vesta Lorraine} runs a sculpture gallery on @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.nLrpWOo3BjHLB0FG]{Proteus Secundus}, located in the upper levels of Hive Raghul. It features pieces from across the Imperium, some of which predate the founding of the Macharian Sector. Most of the pieces are abstract, and their meanings have been lost to antiquity. All are in remarkably well-preserved condition. Everything is for sale, though only those who dwell in the spire’s highest levels have the resources or influence to acquire such works.

32.en: When meeting with clients, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.DiCcUGLaqWptKqE9]{Vesta} delivers an anecdote about each piece. Some deal with the speculated meaning of the sculpture, while others discuss the materials used or the world of origin. In some cases, they explain how the sculpture entered their gallery. In most cases, the stories mention how she first encountered the work while serving as seneschal to the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.X5EFP7IgIUx6CaBW#rogue-traders-of-note]{Klaskoloff Dynasty}. Vesta loves to namedrop, and any time the story can include a prominent member of spire society, she makes it a point to include the name or at least allude to it.

36.en: The art gallery is not @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.DiCcUGLaqWptKqE9]{Vesta}’s only source of income. It works well to grow her client base and allay the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.gQxTENJSdTQTVfDM]{Vigilites'} interest in her business, however Vesta also participates in the Silent Trade, acting as a broker for illicit xenos goods between interested parties. She has a variety of xenotech artefacts hidden in stashes across the hive and her gallery. She suggests that these were acquired during their service to the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.X5EFP7IgIUx6CaBW#rogue-traders-of-note]{Klakoloff Dynasty} but never explicitly stated as much. Notably, new items continue to enter this collection, suggesting that Vesta maintains active connections with Silent Trade suppliers. This collection seldom includes weaponry. Instead, it features a range of more esoteric devices, many of which she claims are merely convenience items from different xenos cultures.

40.en: If asked, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.DiCcUGLaqWptKqE9]{Vesta} refuses to explain how or when she left the service of the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.X5EFP7IgIUx6CaBW#rogue-traders-of-note]{Klaskoloff Dynasty}. If the characters follow up or investigate the Rogue Trader’s affiliates, they deny any knowledge of Vesta. However, they do so with a wink and a smile.

52.en: A noble attempted to sell a sculpture to @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.DiCcUGLaqWptKqE9]{Vesta}. While the piece was exceptional, she believes it is a dangerous xenos artefact. Vesta refused to buy the cursed thing but wants the seller tracked down and the piece destroyed before it does any damage and outs her operations.

60.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.DiCcUGLaqWptKqE9]{Vesta} acquired a spiralling sculpture that resembles chitinous armour plates. After displaying it for only a few days, she believes she can hear faint whispers emanating from the object and has not slept properly since. She hopes the characters take it off her hands and adequately dispose of it.

76.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.DiCcUGLaqWptKqE9]{Vesta} is familiar with many xenotech artefacts. She can often identify their origins and sometimes a general understanding of their functions in exchange for service.

84.en: Becoming significantly indebted to the characters, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.DiCcUGLaqWptKqE9]{Vesta} may invite them to a Silent Trade secret auction. These auctions include many sculptures and works of art, among them xenos artefacts in disguise that fall under the Inquisition’s purview.

92.en: If the characters do seek xenos weaponry, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.DiCcUGLaqWptKqE9]{Vesta} has several contacts in the Silent Trade with whom she can arrange meetings. However, the characters need a high level of influence before she entertains this idea.
